blocks.content:
When calibration succeeds, the watcher starts running on its own at the interval you set in **Repeats**. The **Schedule** card on the watcher's page shows the **Cadence**, **Last run**, and **Next run**.

**Run now** adds one extra run right away, so you don't have to wait for the next automatic run. The **Active** switch at the top of the page turns the automatic runs on and off. Turning it off pauses the watcher without deleting it.

Runs don't overlap. If a run is already in progress, the next one waits or is skipped.

whenTrue.content:
Pop this guide out into a floating window.

If it's docked in the sidebar, this keeps **Run now** and the **Active** switch visible.

blocks.content: To run the watcher, complete the following steps:

blocks.hint: Skip if you are already on the Watchers list or a watcher detail page.

blocks.content: Click the name of the watcher you just created to open its page.

Click **Run now**.

The watcher runs once, right away, in addition to its automatic runs. The new run appears at the top of the **Run history** tab.
blocks.hint: If **Run now** isn't available, check on the **Calibration** tab that calibration finished.

blocks.content: Optional: To see how pausing works, turn off the **Active** switch, to the left of **Run now**. Then turn it back on so the watcher keeps running on its schedule.
You triggered **Run now** and know how to pause the automatic runs. In the next milestone, you'll review the run report.
